newsitem.title: USA: Children's Broadcasting gets note for deal.
newsitem.headline: Children's Broadcasting gets note for deal.

text.p: Children's Broadcasting Corp said Tuesday it accepted from Global Broadcasting Co a $3.5 million note as a deposit under a previously announced asset purchase agreement.
The note is secured by assets of Global Broadcasting.

Children's Broadcasting is selling its 14 owned and operated AM radio stations for the aggregate sale price of $72.5 million. The purchase price is payable in cash at closing, which is anticipated to occur in approximately five months.
The sale of the radio stations is subject to shareholder approvals and customary closing conditions.
In July, Children's Broadcasting said it signed a definitive agreement with Global Broadcasting to sell its AM radio stations.
